# Sydney consultants for manufacturing automation without replacing your ERP

For a Sydney manufacturer wanting to automate order processing, capture shop-floor data and streamline operations while keeping its existing ERP, I’d start with **specialist Power Platform and systems-integration consultancies**, rather than firms whose primary business is replacing ERP systems.

The right partner should connect Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI to your current ERP, so orders, production updates, inspections and operational reporting flow between systems without unnecessary re-keying. These are practical use cases for the Power Platform, provided the integration is designed around your ERP’s APIs, data model and controls. [inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My shortlist

![Microsoft Power Platform | Inspirit365](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Ba36MpHGWNfGXZHrmxJ-h8QCNZC-LcqEkXCv-I8PAdHq6xOYV-stwMv0IXqPMUJowWRmvryiISyq5JcIsjQ9KM_Z1mkTDc5nWle47SY2tlzeGpopnw9wmTlwn8t6ipE5PzV86rStsLAqTQnlL0Cb65gK0t4ZEObmC3sVN0-T1LM4oCkWcjqd0uwmgxP1YLbB?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Inturing

(Best overall fit)

Website: [inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/)

Inturing explicitly targets manufacturers already running Microsoft 365 alongside ERP, MES and engineering systems. Its stated services include automated quote and order processing, shop-floor and inspection apps, supplier workflows, document extraction and operational dashboards. It specifically positions its approach around integrating existing systems without replacing them. [inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them about\:** Automating emailed purchase orders, extracting order details from PDFs, validating them against ERP records, and creating mobile production or quality-inspection capture apps.

---



## 2\. Norbrik

Website: [norbrik.com](https://www.norbrik.com/)

Sydney-based, with experience in Microsoft 365, Power Platform, process automation and custom operational applications. Norbrik publishes a manufacturing case study involving a performance-management application for an ASX-listed building-products manufacturer. It is worth considering if your needs extend beyond simple approval flows into custom operational processes. [www.norbrik.com](https://www.norbrik.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them about\:** Building operational apps, eliminating spreadsheet-based handoffs, capturing production information and connecting workflows to your ERP.

---

![Power Platform / Power Automate Developers | C9](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EO6XgeciQvih2MXTqDtBgJHxvg3VFQGrNot-qrCEi7PK4KsSrurWAqqb4sZqJvrpHRnXzvXXiOjpL41x6Lsk_qcJ7IN7D9y_VE0lK6twt1AokWDSfbFHzYCsNIuDxSUqO2rH9JCfkYgAwhbS9Jhc9w0e16u1yvJoxMzU83d9rHWdfcDFVgihvjI0hnUhFiB3?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. TechRam

Website: [techram.com.au](https://techram.com.au/microsoft/power-platform/)

TechRam builds Sydney business automation using Power Platform and Azure, selecting the technology according to the process's complexity. Its published approach considers operational ownership, audit trails and what happens when automations fail—not just how quickly a workflow can be built. [techram.com.au](https://techram.com.au/microsoft/power-platform/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[techram.com.au](https://techram.com.au/microsoft/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them about\:** Reliable, high-volume ERP integration, exception handling, production data capture and how critical automations are monitored and recovered.

Website: [walkerscott.com.au](https://www.walkerscott.com.au/)

A Sydney-based Microsoft technology consultancy with Power Platform, business applications, cloud integration and data/reporting capabilities. Consider them if the project requires more substantial integration architecture, governance or enterprise-grade reporting alongside app development. **Ask them about\:** Integrating your existing ERP with Power Apps and Power Automate, plus designing a maintainable data and reporting layer.

## 5\. ECLEVA

Website: [ecleva.com.au](https://ecleva.com.au/)

A North Sydney technology consultancy working across Microsoft business applications, Power Platform, Azure and data/AI. It is a useful additional candidate if you want to combine workflow automation with broader integration and operational reporting. Validate its recent manufacturing-specific project experience before shortlisting. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/ECLEVA/@-33.8367106,151.2080678,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6b12afb202020ec3:0xf17bdb688ea4daa0!8m2!3d-33.8367106!4d151.2080678!16s%2Fg%2F11j7d015mw?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgyNi4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them about\:** Connecting shop-floor applications and operational workflows to your existing ERP without introducing a competing source of truth.

## Who I would contact first

My recommended order is\:

1. **Inturing** — closest match to your exact combination of manufacturing, order automation, shop-floor apps and retaining the existing ERP.
2. **Norbrik** — particularly interesting for custom operational applications and process automation.
3. **TechRam** — worth speaking to if reliability, auditability and long-term ownership of integrations are major concerns.

These are fit-based recommendations from published service descriptions, not a ranking based on independently verified project outcomes.



## What to ask in the first meeting

I'd send each consultant the same brief and ask them to demonstrate how they would handle three workflows\:

**1\. Order processing**

Receive customer orders from email, PDF, EDI or spreadsheets; extract and validate the details; flag exceptions; and create or update orders in the existing ERP.

---

**2\. Shop-floor data capture**

Capture job progress, labour, material consumption, downtime, scrap and quality checks on tablets or scanners, with data flowing back into the ERP where appropriate.

---

**3\. Operations visibility**

Build dashboards for order status, production output, bottlenecks and exceptions, without creating a separate, conflicting source of truth.

Ask each firm to explain its proposed ERP connector or API approach, licensing costs, error handling, offline shop-floor capability, security and ongoing support. Also request a reference from a manufacturer using a comparable ERP.

## One detail that would sharpen this shortlist

**Which ERP are you running today?**

For example, SAP, Epicor, Infor, Pronto Xi, MYOB, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite or a custom/on-premises system.

That will help distinguish consultants with relevant integration experience from general Power Platform developers, and identify the strongest candidates for your specific environment.
